authority_limitation: This verifies blind-memory structure, period coverage and epistemic boundaries only. It does not verify any historical shipping claim against external Evidence.
known_limitations: One model vintage is not an independent corroborating source and cannot establish historical truth.

Blind model recall is uneven: famous cycles and large public companies are likely overrepresented; private shipping, regional cabotage, smaller ports, labor, insurance/P&I, classification societies, naval architecture suppliers and non-English histories may be under-recalled.
1970s-1990s exact company/port/rule chronology is especially vulnerable to recall compression and must be decomposed into claim-scoped Evidence tasks.
2025-2026 current-state memory is explicitly treated as sparse/stale risk and must not be used as a current market snapshot.
The atlas is saturated only for this blind pass. A materially different model vintage should create a new immutable atlas and diff known/refined/novel leads.
recommended_next_step: Generate bounded post-seal Evidence tasks from the highest-value historical Judgment families and cross-cycle metrics, preserving exact source known-time and reverse-query guards.
